operation_details.item: The user uses Notion for article outlines.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the article workflow going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty smoothly. I’m organizing a few new pieces and refining the planning stage before drafting.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What are you using to map out the articles?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Notion for my article outlines. It’s convenient for arranging sections and moving ideas around.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: And once the outline is settled, do you move into your long-form drafting setup?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I use Scrivener for long-form drafts. For collaborative edits, I switch to Google Docs.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a well-defined process. How do you keep the writing consistent across projects?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I keep a shared style guide for all projects, so everyone has the same reference while editing.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I use Notion for outlines, while keeping the other tools and the style guide.
